name: The Westin Cairo Golf Resort & Spa, Katameya Dunes

address.street: The Westin Cairo Golf Resort & Spa

insider_take: Desert oasis meets championship golf in Egypt's capital, where ancient pyramids serve as your backdrop while you perfect your swing.
whats_special: This resort sits on the only Nick Faldo-designed championship golf course in Egypt, featuring 27 holes carved through natural sand dunes. The property offers stunning views of the Mokattam Hills and is just 20 minutes from the Great Pyramids of Giza. The resort's Heavenly Spa treatments incorporate ancient Egyptian wellness traditions with modern techniques.
pro_tip: Book tee times during sunrise or sunset for the most spectacular desert lighting and cooler temperatures. The golden hour creates magical photo opportunities with the dunes as your backdrop.
dont_miss: The resort's signature dining at Fairways Restaurant overlooks the 18th hole, while the nearby Katameya Heights area offers upscale shopping. Take advantage of the complimentary shuttle to explore Old Cairo's Islamic monuments and the world-famous Khan el-Khalili bazaar for authentic Egyptian crafts and spices.
pros: Championship golf course designed by Nick Faldo
Luxurious resort setting away from city center
Multiple dining venues and recreational amenities
